title: Mold Remediation Insured's Own Share: Amount Owed by the Customer
content:
**Rule.** The insured's own share of a Mold Remediation job is the job's charge total less the customer payments already posted to the job, rounded to the cent, half up.

**Definitions.** The job's charge total is every charge line booked on the job; its mold-covered total is its remediation scope, equipment day and clearance fee lines. The claim file's deductible is assessed and collected on the claim file, never on the job, and is not part of the insured's own share.

**How the figures combine.** Every write-down taken on the job is taken off both the charge total and the mold-covered total; an amount carried under other coverage is taken off the mold-covered total, which is never below 0.00; what remains of the mold-covered total is capped at the coverage limit; the carrier-payable amount is that capped figure plus the amount carried under other coverage; the insured's own share is the charge total less every write-down, less the carrier-payable amount, less the customer payments already posted, never below 0.00 and rounded once to the cent, half up.

| Quantity | Lines it takes in |
|---|---|
| Charge total | Every charge line on the job, including late fees, card surcharges and cancellation fees |
| Mold-covered total | Remediation scope lines, equipment day lines and clearance fee lines only |
| Customer payments already posted | The customer's own payments on the job; insurance postings and credits are not customer payments |
| Deductible | Never part of the share |

**Worked figures, hypothetical inputs.**

1. Charge total 4210.35, customer payments already posted 1000.00: the share is 3210.35.
2. Charge total 860.00, customer payments already posted 900.00: the result would be below zero, so the share is 0.00.
